scope: Native automatic probe and mechanical adjustment pipeline. Configuration assembly, product endpoint and physical hardware acceptance are still pending.

scenarios: three offset-corrected probe points with native stop/recovery
flat decimal height .88 without spurious displacement
zero retries applies once without claiming tolerance
retry exhaustion stops before another correction
two consecutive range increases stop calibration

semantics.tolerance: Compare full precision measured range, no six-decimal rounding.
semantics.measuredRange: Last probe pass before its correction, not a post-correction physical measurement.
semantics.exhaustion: Reject before another correction when retry budget is exhausted.
semantics.maximumTravel: Per adjustment pass; each pass also checks configured Z range.

planning.scope: Plane fit and bounded per-motor planning only; no probing, step generation or hardware

execution.scope: Three Z motors, two physical segments and final coordinate rebase. Includes simulated MCU clock waits, stop confirmations and native step generation; excludes probing and setup. Not physical hardware or an equal-work Python comparison.

limitations: No real probe, step loss or motion accuracy acceptance.
Per-segment step rounding remains as documented in native-z-tilt-acceptance.json.
Historical Node crashes and motion numerical mismatches are not closed by these successful runs.
